title: Assurance policy
description: How much evidence a change must carry before it may be called done. Four built-in profiles (explore < rapid < balanced < strict) are a fixed lattice; a named profile extends one and may only tighten it; floors are minimums the policy may raise and never lower. Nothing here changes what the safety hooks deny.

default.description: Profile used when the selection is `adaptive` and no floor raises it.

maxLoanMinutes.description: Longest fast loan the project allows. The hard ceiling is 1440 (24 hours).

profiles.description: Named profiles. Each extends a built-in or another named profile and may only tighten controls.

risk.description: Minimum profile per task risk. Hard minima: low >= rapid, medium >= balanced, high >= strict.

impact.description: Applied when a change hits unmapped, global, overlapping, or shared paths, or Git is unavailable. Hard minimum: balanced.

protectedAttributes.description: Applied when an affected module declares security, safety, or privacy at critical or high. Hard minimum: strict.

criticalHighAttributes.description: Applied when an affected module declares any other attribute at critical or high. Hard minimum: balanced.

paths.description: Glob-based floors. An empty list disables path floors for the project.
